theme.description: Pocket Anchor is designed as a warm, tactile, contemplative digital haven for mental health crisis, nomadic medical continuity, and survivor safety. It intentionally rejects clinical, cold, or alarmist design in favor of soft natural tones, organic depth, thoughtful micro-animations, and empathetic hierarchy.

hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-normal tracking-tight leading-snug

pillar_1.title: Sanctuary & Silent Support
pillar_1.subtitle: Crisis De-escalation, Emotional Anchoring & Shared Compassion
features: Mood Pulse interactive animated orb (Grounded/Willow Grove, Hopeful/Mimosa, Struggling/Azul)
Anchor Link public page ('Give [Name] a reason to stay') with anonymous supportive notes and voice clips
Wall of Hope masonry feed with real-time 'Felt this' and warm light reactions
Emergency Archive (Break Glass Protocol) with one-click crisis pack release to trusted guardians
Private Journal with mood spectrum color mapping and emotional triggers tags
Guardian Dashboard with silent status indicators and safety check-ins
Memory Vault for uplifting audio messages, photos, and safety reasons
Guided Breathing Exercises player (4-7-8, Box Breathing, Gentle Ocean Wave with haptic/visual pacing)
14-Day Mood Rhythm Chart with contextual insight triggers
SOS Floating Action Dock with 988 lifeline direct trigger and silent SOS

pillar_2.title: Nomadic Health & Medical Vault
pillar_2.subtitle: Decentralized Care Infrastructure for Travelers & Digital Nomads
features: Spatial Health Guide (Interactive OpenStreetMap / Clinic Locator with emergency wait times & language tags)
Medical Vault (Client-side encrypted emergency records, allergies, blood type, and ICE contacts)
Care Orchestrator (Cross-border prescription routing, insurance claiming, time-zone medication sync)
Proactive Monitor (Altitude, travel fatigue, vaccination validity, malaria prophylaxis tracker)
Global Doctor Network (Verified multilingual telemedicine practitioners available across time zones)

pillar_3.title: Survivor & IPV Support Services
pillar_3.subtitle: Discreet, End-to-End Safety, Legal & Recovery Infrastructure
features: Quick-Exit & Instant Screen Blur (Key shortcut 'Esc x 2' or one-tap masquerade switch to weather/news mode)
Survivor Navigator AI Chatbot (Trauma-informed, zero-retention safe conversational companion)
Resource Directory (Geolocated emergency shelters, vetted legal advocates, discrete transit funds)
Encrypted Evidence Vault (Tamper-evident timestamped photos, audio notes, incident logbook with decoy password)
Rebuilding Action Plan Tracker (Four holistic tracks: Safe Housing, Financial Autonomy, Emotional Healing, Legal & Identity Protection)

elements: Pocket Anchor Brand Emblem (Stone & Leaf minimalist crest)
Pillar Switcher Tabs (Sanctuary, Health Infrastructure, Survivor Support)

auth_modal.description: Warm, non-intrusive dialog with Google One-Tap, Magic Link, and anonymous guest sanctuary mode.

onboarding_modal.description: 3-step gentle setup: 1. Name your Sanctuary, 2. Choose default Mood Orbit tone, 3. Generate secure shareable Anchor Link 'app.anchor/with/your-name'.

mood_pulse_orb.description: Fluid animated canvas/CSS orb with 3 states: Willow Grove (Grounded), Mimosa (Hopeful), Azul (Struggling). Features tactile slider for mood intensity and quick note addition.

anchor_public_page.description: Public interactive portal for 'Give [Name] a reason to stay'. Allows friends, family, or anonymous kindred souls to leave warmth messages, voice recordings, photo keepsakes, and song recommendations with zero login required.

wall_of_hope.description: Masonry responsive feed of uplifting messages, survival milestones, and quotes. Includes interactive 'Felt this' counter, 'Send warmth' micro-firefly animation, and filter tags.

emergency_archive.description: The 'Break Glass' safety locker. If triggered, instantly reveals pre-written anchor letters, safe contacts, emergency survival kit, and unlocks emergency guardian notifications.

private_journal.description: Rich text journal with mood color tinting, voice recording dictation simulator, emotion tag chips, and zero-knowledge client encryption toggle.

breathing_exercises.description: Audio-visual breathing pacer with 3 selectable techniques: 4-7-8 Deep Sleep, Box Breathing Focus, and Gentle Wave Ocean Rhythm. Visual expanding ring with soothing countdown cues.

spatial_health_guide.description: Interactive map & clinic finder for nomads: filters by 24/7 emergency, English/multilingual doctors, pharmacy, dental, walk-in cost transparency, and offline directions cache.

medical_vault.description: Encrypted health locker: Blood type, drug allergies, active prescriptions with international brand name converter, vaccination QR passes, and downloadable offline emergency card.

survivor_navigator.description: Compassionate, trauma-informed AI support chatbot. Built with empathetic prompting, immediate de-escalation scripts, local resource lookup, and instant chat purge button.

evidence_vault.description: Discrete, high-security incident log with timestamping, encrypted photo/document attachments, metadata stripping, and decoy password protection ('Notes & Recipes').

rebuilding_plan.description: Interactive recovery roadmap across 4 key pillars: 1. Safe Housing, 2. Financial Independence, 3. Emotional Reconnection, 4. Legal & Identity Renewal.

quick_exit_banner.description: Persistent floating safety trigger with double-esc hotkey binding, instant decoy screen redirect to Google Weather, and screen blur overlay.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Follow the mandatory 6-color palette strictly: Cloud (#FBFBF9), Azul (#9197AA), Mimosa (#F7B557), Orange (#C1521E), Aperol (#F36B38), and Willow Grove (#4C5D4B).
2. Use Cormorant Garamond for all headings (h1 to h3) and DM Sans for body text. Load fonts properly in index.html / index.css.
3. Implement the 3 Core Functional Pillars with a fluid, seamless tab switcher: 1) Mental Health & Silent Support, 2) Nomadic Health & Medical Infrastructure, 3) Survivor & IPV Support Services.
4. Ensure the Quick Exit button and Screen Blur hotkey (Esc key or click) work reliably on all views with a realistic neutral decoy view ('Daily Weather & News').

5. Include all requested features: Auth Modal (Google/Email/Anonymous), Sanctuary Onboarding (generates link 'app.anchor/with/[name]'), Mood Pulse animated orb (Willow Grove/Mimosa/Azul), Wall of Hope with 'Felt this' counters, Emergency Archive ('Break Glass'), Private Journal, Guardian Dashboard, Memory Vault, Breathing Player (4-7-8, Box, Wave), 14-day Mood chart, Spatial Health Guide with interactive clinic search & map, Medical Vault with international prescription translations, Survivor Navigator AI Chatbot, Evidence Vault with decoy toggle, and Rebuilding Action Plan Tracker.
6. Ensure all interactive and key data elements include explicit 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case format for automated testing.
7. Never use pure transparent backgrounds for navbars, modals, or dropdowns. Always provide solid or glassmorphic tinted backgrounds (e.g., bg-[#FBFBF9]/90 with backdrop-blur-xl).
8. Deliver a responsive, deeply empathetic, polished, top 1% UI with serene micro-animations, rich tactile interactions, and zero clinical harshness.
